ContentTypes.description: List of content types. Fields must be attached through a content part whose PartName matches the content type's Name. Those parts must also appear in the ContentPartFieldDefinitionRecords inside ContentParts. Fields cannot be used directly in PartName.

DisplayName.description: Display name shown in the Orchard admin UI.

Creatable.description: Whether editors can create new items of this type.

Listable.description: Whether items of this type appear in content lists.

Draftable.description: Whether items of this type support drafts.

ContentTypeSettings.description: Standard Orchard Core content type settings.

Settings.description: Content type settings object, including standard Orchard ContentTypeSettings.

PartName.description: Attached part type name. Known part names are surfaced as suggestions, but any custom part name is allowed.

Name.description: Attachment name used on the content type. Usually matches PartName.

DisplayName.description: Display label shown in the admin UI.

Position.description: Placement position used by Orchard when rendering the part or field.

DisplayMode.description: Display mode selected for the part or field.

Editor.description: Editor name used to edit the part or field.

Settings.description: Attachment settings for this part on the content type.

AccountPartSettings.description: The settings of the account part.

OfferedContentTypes.description: The record types (such as contacts and opportunities) already added to the account type's list. The Accounts feature adds every new record type to the list once and records it here, so a type an administrator removes from the list is not added back.

Pattern.description: Pattern for generating the alias. Must be valid Liquid syntax.

Options.description: Whether the alias is editable or auto-generated.

Pattern.description: The pattern used to build the Path. Must be valid Liquid syntax.

LeadPartSettings.description: How a lead of this type is converted.

TargetContactContentType.description: The contact content type a lead of this type becomes when it is converted.

DefaultOpportunityContentType.description: The opportunity content type offered first when a conversion creates an opportunity.

RequireTimeZone.description: Require a time zone for the contact.

AutoDetectTimeZone.description: Automatically detect the contact time zone from the contact's phone number when one was not selected.

UseDoNotCall.description: Show the Do not call preference.

UseDoNotSms.description: Show the Do not SMS preference.

UseDoNotEmail.description: Show the Do not email preference.

OpportunityPartSettings.description: The pipeline of an opportunity type.

StageIds.description: The ItemIds of the stages (see the OmnichannelOpportunityStage step) an opportunity of this type moves through. Empty uses every stage.

Pattern.description: Pattern for building the preview path or display content.

Type.description: The kind of product the part represents.

DefaultCurrency.description: The ISO-4217 currency code applied to products of this type when an item does not set its own currency.

SalesMode.description: Whether products of this type can be bought online, are only listed, or decide per item.

PriceDisplay.description: How the price of products of this type is shown to visitors.

OnRequestLabel.description: The text shown instead of the price when the price is shown on request.

AllowPriceDisplayOverride.description: Whether each product may choose how its own price is shown.

IsContentRestricted.description: Whether content that uses this part is restricted to the selected roles.

Required.description: Whether at least one role must be picked.

AllowSelectMultiple.description: Whether more than one role may be picked.

ExcludedRoles.description: The role names that are not offered.

Hint.description: The hint shown under the picker.

SchemaOrgPartSettings.description: The schema.org type of the content items and where each of their properties comes from.

SchemaType.description: The schema.org type, such as BlogPosting, Article, Event or Product. When empty, a module may choose one (a product is a Product); other items are a WebPage.

Name.description: The schema.org property, such as headline. A dotted name, such as offers.price, sets a property of a nested object.

Source.description: Where the value comes from: Content (a field or value of the item), Fixed (the same value for every item), Editor (entered on each item) or Liquid (a template).

Value.description: What the source needs: for Content the key of a field or value, such as Field:BlogPost.Image or Item:DisplayText; for Fixed the value itself; for Liquid the template; unused for Editor.

Properties.description: The properties and where their values come from, in the order they are written.

ContentTypes.description: The content types for which the subscription flow collects content item data.

DefaultTaxCategoryCode.description: The default tax category code applied to new content items.

DefaultTaxClassificationCode.description: The default tax classification code applied to new content items.

AllowClassificationOverride.description: Whether the tax classification fields are shown to editors.

Pattern.description: This string must be a valid Liquid syntax

allOf.description: The part has no settings of its own.

WizardPartSettings.description: How the wizard's steps are authored and how a started wizard behaves.

ContainedContentTypes.description: The content types allowed as steps. Empty allows every type that matches ContainedStereotypes.

ContainedStereotypes.description: The stereotypes allowed as steps. Empty does not filter by stereotype.

DisplayType.description: The display type each step is rendered with in the authoring editor.

CollapseContainedItems.description: Whether steps are collapsed by default in the authoring editor.

RequiresAuthenticatedUser.description: Whether a visitor must be signed in to start the wizard.

CompletionPolicy.description: What happens to the collected responses when the wizard completes: 0 = None (kept only in the session for a workflow or handler), 1 = Draft (created as drafts), 2 = Publish (created and published, the default).

ContentTypePartDefinitionRecords.description: Parts attached to this content type.

Settings.description: Part definition settings, including part-specific settings envelopes.

FieldName.description: Field type name. Known Orchard field types are surfaced as suggestions, but any custom field type name is allowed.

Name.description: Field name used inside the content part.

DisplayName.description: Display label shown in the admin UI.

Position.description: Placement position used by Orchard when rendering the part or field.

DisplayMode.description: Display mode selected for the part or field.

Editor.description: Editor name used to edit the part or field.

Settings.description: Field definition settings, including Orchard placement/editor settings and field-specific settings envelopes.

Hint.description: The hint shown under the field in the editor.

Required.description: Whether an address must be entered.

ShowName.description: Whether the editor asks for the recipient's name.

ShowCompany.description: Whether the editor asks for a company.

ShowPhone.description: Whether the editor asks for a phone number.

Countries.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries offered; empty or null for every country.

DefaultCountry.description: The country a new address starts in.

Hint.description: The hint shown under the field in the editor.

Required.description: Whether a phone number must be entered.

InitialCountryMode.description: The country the editor starts on: Globe (0, none), CurrentCulture (1, the request culture's country) or Specific (2, SpecificCountryCode).

SpecificCountryCode.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the editor starts on when InitialCountryMode is Specific.

Pattern.description: This string must be valid Liquid syntax when provided.

MinLength.description: The minimum number of characters allowed. Omit it for no minimum.

MaxLength.description: The maximum number of characters allowed. Omit it for no maximum.

ContentPartFieldDefinitionRecords.description: Field definitions that belong to this reusable part.
